license_note: Source-available Fair Source. Keep the source isolated in its own checkout/fork; do not vendor it into generated game repos. Each upstream release becomes Apache-2.0 after two years according to its LICENSE.

studio_map_builder.use: build accepted plans in a verified nonproduction Studio target

asset_pipeline.use: validated model/icon packs and manifests; bridge Blender-authored assets into procedural worlds

browser_preview.use: pre-Studio visual inspection only; not live Studio evidence

bloxui_blueprint.use: prototypes, utility/settings screens, declarative screen/state planning

bloxui_runtime.use: only when project explicitly approves Fusion/BloxUI as part of frontend architecture

bloxui_ai_or_hosted_service.use: bootstrap must remain model/provider neutral and work fully without hosted BloxMaps generation

website_cloud_stack.use: not part of normal game-development bootstrap

toolchain.lune: only needed for local BloxUI server paths
toolchain.rojo: BloxMaps currently pins 7.6.1 in its isolated checkout; do not downgrade the game bootstrap pin 7.7.0
toolchain.isolation: run BloxMaps from its own checkout so its dependencies do not replace project tool pins

security.network_generation: human approval if a task elects to use a hosted/BYOK path
security.studio_mutation: must route through studio-operator target verification and task evidence gates
security.output_boundary_note: Generated plans must stay in ignored local BloxMaps evidence or an issue-local changeset; arbitrary filesystem writes are blocked by the adapter.

agent_policy.visual_design: Use the strongest available runtime-neutral visual workflow. Claude Design is one possible binding, never a canonical dependency.
agent_policy.concurrency: BloxMaps is a tool/capability, not an extra subagent. Existing max 3 active subagents remains unchanged.
agent_policy.ui_owner: frontend-worker with creative-director direction; BloxUI remains optional

upgrade_policy: Never track fork main automatically. Review upstream/fork diff, license/security/dependency changes, run fork tests + bootstrap adapter smoke test, then intentionally move the pinned ref.
